div.p: This page contains artifacts for technical actors (data sources, data recipients/validators, etc.) who may desire to download and use the FHIR conformance artifacts and examples defined within this guide for development, implementation and validation activities within a specified environment.
The entire implementation guide - pages, definitions, examples and validation information - is available as full-ig.zip.
In addition there are format specific definitions files.
